adjudication.rationale: In `GroupsController#members`, the new pagination logic sets `limit = (params[:limit] || 50).to_i` and then applies it directly via `.limit(limit)` with no upper bound or clamping. That means a client can supply an arbitrarily large `limit` and force the server to load and serialize a very large number of users in one request (`members = group.users.order(:username_lower).limit(limit).offset(offset)`), which is a real performance/DoS risk exposed by the diff (and the change also applies this to all groups, not just automatic groups).
